summary: This snapshot is source-complete for the candidate and its immediate reproduction toolchain. It is NOT a complete archival of the experiment, and several categories of artefact are deliberately absent or only hash-recorded. Each item below states what is missing, why, and what it would take to close.

notCopiedBytes.why: Derived 1401x1401 double products, not inputs. 479 MB of the temp sandbox's 545 MB is this.
notCopiedBytes.impact: Cannot inspect the original arrays offline, but they are fully regenerated by repro/verify.ps1 and compared against the recorded SHA-256; 12/12 data products matched bit-for-bit.
notCopiedBytes.howToRecover: Run repro/build.ps1 then repro/verify.ps1; the gallery gate alone reproduces double-heights/float-heights/coastal/land-e/coverage.

notCopiedBytes.what: PNGs larger than 1 MB (6 files, ~41 MB): far-height-shade-annotated.png, far-three-profiles.png, compare/*.png, compare-3a7686/*.png
notCopiedBytes.why: Figures rendered from the CSV/f64be products; large and regenerable.
notCopiedBytes.impact: The published figures themselves are not here. What IS here: the SHA-256 of every one, plus the exact rendering script (original/render-far-x.py, original/compare.py) and its input products.
notCopiedBytes.howToRecover: python original/render-far-x.py indexed   (needs original/indexed/far-grid.csv, which was copied).

notCopiedBytes.why: Third-party artefacts already fully identified by SHA-256 and Maven coordinates; repackaging them would create a duplicate SBOM with no provenance gain.
notCopiedBytes.impact: The build is NOT runnable on a machine without these jars. They are recorded, not bundled.
notCopiedBytes.howToRecover: Each jar in deps/jars.txt carries its exact Gradle cache path, byte size and SHA-256. Register the Gradle/Maven coordinates listed in deps/jars.json in the target project and let Gradle re-download; verify with the recorded hashes. Only the two ForgeGradle-minecraft jars (Forge recomp, client-extra) are not plain Maven artifacts and must come from a ForgeGradle setup of Forge 1.20.1-47.4.10.

notCopiedBytes.what: ~130 unrelated geogenesis-* temp directories (other candidates and experiments)
notCopiedBytes.why: Out of scope; the task is to preserve the current BEA0 candidate only.
notCopiedBytes.impact: Historical candidates are not preserved here. Two of them are referenced as upstream arm inputs and were read (geogenesis-merged-exclusive-9129fd9c..., geogenesis-double-tree-479b36a0...) but only the files actually needed were copied.

sourceCompleteness.status: COMPLETE for what compiles, VERIFIED by compilation not by inspection
sourceCompleteness.method: The 50-file src/main/java closure was derived by compiling and following javac resolution errors, then the whole set was compiled from the preserve root against only the recorded jar list. Exit 0, 395 classes.
residualRisk: Reflection: RecipeMorphCatalog and FullMorphLand read private fields of sibling classes by name (Class.forName / getDeclaredField). If such a reflected class were dropped from the set the code would compile and fail at runtime. Mitigation: the verify pass executes every probe that exercises those paths and reproduces the anchors, so a missing reflected class would surface as an exception, not silence.

The closure is the closure of the 17 candidate + 131 head sources. The other 131 head-tree files that are NOT in the 17/50 set are preserved in full (src/head-terrain-candidate has all 131), so they were not pruned.
src/main-closure contains exactly the 50 files needed. If someone edits a candidate source to reference a new main class, the build will fail loudly with a missing symbol rather than silently differ.

behaviouralGaps.detail: Bit-exact identity of the chunk-index arm was only measured at the default region scale 1200. LandRegionContext at scale 1.0 and 2.5 is refused by DoubleBoundaryGeometry's own site-enumeration guard before the index is reached. The index is scale-agnostic (it unions per-cell segment bboxes) but that is an argument, not a measurement.

behaviouralGaps.gap: Perf numbers are single-machine, correlated batches
behaviouralGaps.detail: Full-e figures use fixed warmup, correlated batches, a repeated point set and one machine. They do not prove JIT convergence or in-game performance. The older PerfE full-e timing was not genuinely warmed and its numbers must not be quoted.

behaviouralGaps.gap: Band-edge probe leaves the 1e-6..1.0 band-adjacent bins empty
behaviouralGaps.detail: Points placed by nextUp/nextDown chains land either within 8 ulp or further than 1e-9 away in practice. The <=120-distance coverage is carried by BandIndexFuzz's 10-block bins instead.

behaviouralGaps.gap: Candidate is not in the repository
behaviouralGaps.detail: BEA0 exists only in temp and in this snapshot. Nothing was committed. Integrating it into the repo is deliberately left to whoever owns that decision; verified/ was not touched per instructions.

measuredHere.build: repro/build.ps1 exit 0, 6 steps, 395 classes, arm bindings asserted
measuredHere.verify: repro/verify.ps1 exit 0, 14 gates + 1 intentional non-zero negative control + anchor compare
measuredHere.perf: repro/perf.ps1 -Rounds 3 exit 0, 900 rows, B==C value signatures identical in all 4 zones, A!=B

notRerunHere: The 1401x1401 A/B PNG comparison (original/compare.py) was NOT re-run because the delivered reference PNG is a repo artefact and the recorded metrics are already frozen; the underlying height arrays were reproduced bit-exactly instead, which is the stronger claim.

The ab-perf.csv / e-perf.csv passes were not re-run: they measure the same geometry code that perf2.csv measures with a better protocol, and the sandbox itself flags the old PerfE full-e timing as not warmed.

aDefectFoundAndFixedWhileAssembling.what: Arm B was initially assembled with the OLD geometry (CF4FCA7E) instead of the Xfix geometry (8C26D068).
aDefectFoundAndFixedWhileAssembling.howDetected: The reproduced perf run showed B==A and B!=C value signatures in every zone, contradicting the frozen record which says B and C share land math and differ only in the cull.
aDefectFoundAndFixedWhileAssembling.fix: Split src/baseline-arms (land only) from src/old-geometry (old geometry, arm A only) and added a build-time assertion that geometry class bytes are B==C and A!=B.
aDefectFoundAndFixedWhileAssembling.result: After the fix B==C and A!=B in all four zones, matching the frozen record. This is exactly the class of silent-collapse error the original sandbox's run-stage.ps1 comments warn about, so the assertion is now permanent.
